inlines.v: DREADFUL, adjective 1. Impressing great fear; terrible; formidable; as a dreadful storm, or dreadful night. The great and dreadful day of the Lord. Malachi 4:5. 2. Awful; venerable. How dreadful is this place. Genesis 48:1.
